_readme: Labelled topics for `npm run jev:eval -- --set routing`. `regulatory` is whether the drafting model should be handed statute at all; `expected` is which corpora it should be routed to (empty = none of the six); `alsoAcceptable` lists corpora that would not be wrong. The labels are an editorial judgement — edit them. Published articles are added at run time, unlabelled.
